decision: Retain the capability-scoped rows>=4096 constrained recoloring. It is exact and non-regressive, removes 28.6875 MiB tracked and about 31.47 MiB whole-device VRAM at 4K/8K, and leaves short-row verifier/NextN coloring unchanged.
